title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 25H (Re-employment of retrenched workmen)

content.overview: Section 25H gives retrenched workmen a preference for re-employment when the employer proposes to take into employment any person.
content.glance: Section 25H gives retrenched workmen a preference for re-employment when the employer proposes to take into employment any person.
content.study: Where an employer proposes to take into employment any person, he shall give an opportunity to the retrenched workmen who offer themselves for re-employment, and they shall have preference over other persons.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 25H gives retrenched workmen a preference for re-employment when the employer proposes to take into employment any person.
